verdict.rationale: Unity documents Sentis (com.unity.ai.inference) as its official neural network inference library, which imports trained models and runs them in real time on the target device's compute resources. A registry probe confirms the package resolves as Unity's on-device ML inference library for games. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-game model execution, documented detail on supported model formats, compute backends and per-platform coverage.
